prose: Basis: Forbes blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. Anthropic's IPO paperwork outlines an unusual succession plan: confidential, ranked lists of up to ten successors per founder, with any succession subject to approval from five cofounders. It is a private line of inheritance for the founders' voting power - continuity planning for a company whose governance is deliberately concentrated.
